payload.title: Speed kept through the break predicts separation
payload.method: Hypothesis: the share of top drill speed a receiver keeps through a change of direction in combine_tracking predicts T1 beyond the stopwatch card. Falsified if the holdout gain over the card baseline is not above zero with the bootstrap interval.
payload.target: T1: WR separation over expected on breaking routes (rookie season). T2, rookie snap share, is scored alongside for every athlete in the cohort as the missingness anchor.
payload.predictionTime: Pre-draft: after the combine, before the draft. No later information.
payload.cohort: Wide receivers with combine_results rows, draft classes 2023-2025.
payload.featureCutoff: combine_results + combine_tracking only. No pro day, no college production, no post-draft or in-season fields; post-play-fields.json is excluded by rule.
payload.splitPolicy: 2023-2024 draft classes = develop; 2025 = untouched holdout, split by athlete, opened once after registration is frozen.
payload.baseline: Stopwatch card (forty, ten_yd_split, combine_height, combine_weight, position) linear model, plus a cohort-mean naive benchmark. Market baseline = card + draft_overall_pick.
payload.metric: Holdout MAE and R-squared versus the card baseline and versus the market baseline; paired bootstrap by athlete for the difference.
payload.exclusions: Athletes without combine_tracking are kept in T2 and reported as missing for T1, never imputed. No athlete appears in both develop and holdout.

payload.title: Deceleration into the cut and re-acceleration out of it
payload.method: Hypothesis: peak deceleration entering a cut and acceleration leaving it, from combine_tracking, predict T1 beyond the card. Falsified as above; reported per measure, no post-hoc combination.
payload.target: T1: WR separation over expected on breaking routes (rookie season). T2, rookie snap share, is scored alongside for every athlete in the cohort as the missingness anchor.

payload.baseline: Stopwatch card (forty, ten_yd_split, combine_height, combine_weight, position) linear model, plus a cohort-mean naive benchmark. Market baseline = card + draft_overall_pick.
payload.metric: Holdout MAE and R-squared versus the card baseline and versus the market baseline; paired bootstrap by athlete for the difference.
payload.exclusions: Athletes without combine_tracking are kept in T2 and reported as missing for T1, never imputed. No athlete appears in both develop and holdout.
